The News Media Monitoring Pipeline collects article metadata, summaries, and engagement signals from online
outlets. This sample document is designed for document extraction tests and intentionally includes paragraphs,
bordered tables, borderless tables, and several images.
During the latest monitoring window, editors tracked rising coverage of elections, AI investments, and live sports
rights. The content below includes special characters such as Ž, č, š, and café so encoding-aware processing can be
verified during extraction.
A downstream parser can extract body text with pdfplumber or python-docx, then store the normalized text and
metadata in MongoDB together with source path, page number, and extraction timestamp.
